entities.summary: Tadeusz Miciński (1873-1918) was a Polish poet, novelist, and playwright associated with the Young Poland movement. Known for his mystical and symbolist themes, Miciński's works often explore the human psyche, existential questions, and the metaphysical aspects of reality. Tadeusz Miciński was a poets & playwrights from Łódź (1873-11-09, Łódź–1918-02-01). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
